notes.title: Hot Fixes - Week 1
notes.notes:
[h3]Latest Patches[/h3]
Thank you for the warm welcome you gave to Effigy since its release last week ! We wanted to be transparent and share with you the latest news regarding updates to the game.

Recap of recent fixes available in-the last game updates :
- FIXED : QWERTY Inputs available (in addition to the original AZERTY)
- FIXED : Some light statues were not emitting any light
- FIXED : Multiple fixes on the light detection system
- ADDED : UI to introduce mechanics (Shift to sprint, F to toggle light, etc.)

Known issues :
- We are currently investigating an issue that may lead to random crashes. Those crashes are extremely rare so if you have any clue on why / when they occur feel free to let us know !


[h3]Future Updates[/h3]
As you may have read on our store page, the Efficiency team is composed of 10 students currently in their last year of studies. That mean we are currently in the final rush of another project and have a limited time to work on improvements for Effigy : The Descent.

We can't promise any addition of content but do not hesitate to share your feedback !


[h3]Sharing for friends[/h3]
Another team of students is also releasing their game in the next few days. Do not hesitate to Wishlist their game : Escape Abstraction ! You may not have statues in it but you will have to escape for sure.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580850/Escape_Abstraction/?beta=0



[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Thank you again for all the love around Effigy : The Descent ! Do not hesitate to share with us any content you produce or feedback you may have !

notes.title: Effigy : The Descent is out NOW !
notes.notes:
After 4 months of development and a year of final adjustments we are happy to finally release Effigy : The Descent.

To celebrate the launch we are happy to offer you a -40% discount !

We hope you will enjoy the game. See you soon in the cave ?
I hope you have your lantern with you !
